signals.name: FuelLevel
signals.description: Fuel sender counts from CAN 0x50C D3:D4 (LE). Calibrated 2026-07-11 across 15 captures: 2358 counts = full (3x idle 06-15, ceiling never exceeded), 2060-2062 = low-fuel lamp (~10% assumed reserve); DTE cross-check linear r=0.995 over 2062-2320. Supersedes the 1.0.5 D3-only read (x2 = %): D3 is the low byte of this 16-bit counter and wraps mod 256 (full tank 0x0936 read 108%; draining past 0x0900 crashed the reading to 0 then 255). 0x5CD D0 (pre-1.0.5 mapping) read a constant ~50 through a physical near-empty-to-full refuel and is not fuel.

signals.name: BatteryVoltage
signals.description: 12V battery voltage from CAN 0x367 D4 (Kona gateway). Validated 2026-06-22 captures: 13.6V driving, 12.8V dip as engine shut off at pump. Veloster 0x545 absent and Elantra 0x568 D3 zeroed on Kona. Confidence: high.
